random.title: How one farm returned $400k in a year with a small autonomous tractor
random.originalTitle: How one farm returned $400k in a year with a small autonomous tractor
random.summary: 農業機械の新製品・技術・現場動向を紹介する海外記事です。
random.originalSummary: At a family farm in Kentucky, in the United States, a no-frills 135-horsepower John Deere 6135E now plants itself - accurate to within a centimetre and allowing the farm to reallocate labour. An autonomous retrofit kit, from US company Sabanto, has let farmer Quint Pottinger swap out 2 300-horsepower tractors, 2 40-foot planters and a second combine for a smaller, self-driving setup that finished planting 10 days faster.
